rule: Leases keyed by actual physical_resource_id, never by software station name. Acquire all required resource leases atomically before a qualified service accepts a job; same owner may retain but two distinct jobs cannot simultaneously own one resource. No real lease is created by this package.
release_gate: Terminal acknowledged jobs, independent physical safe-state and accepted receiving custody; a timeout, failed analysis or stop request does not release a lease.
unknown_mapping: HOLD; do not assume independent resources from distinct station IDs
on_communications_loss: Retain last accepted custody and leases. Await independent qualified state. No blind retry or autonomous unload.
